meta.title: Privacy Policy · DropFlow
meta.description: Your files stay on your device. What DropFlow stores, what it sends, and to whom.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lead: DropFlow converts and processes your files on your own device. This page explains in plain words what that means, and the few cases where the internet is involved.

ul: Your files are processed on your own device. Their contents are never uploaded to us or to anyone else.
No accounts. No ads. No analytics and no tracking.
The internet is used only for the few things listed below, and each one is started by you or described here.

p: DropFlow is made by Moustafa Hamwi. In this policy, "DropFlow", "we" and "us" mean the DropFlow software (the Windows app and the web app on this website) and its owner.

In the Windows app the work is done by programs on your PC. In the browser it is done by the page itself, in Web Workers using WebAssembly. Either way, we do not receive your files, their names, or anything about what is inside them.
In the browser, files are held in memory only while the page is open. Closing or reloading the tab discards them. Results are offered to you as downloads to your own device.

ul: No file contents, file names or file metadata.
No accounts, registration, email addresses or payment details.
No analytics, advertising, tracking pixels or fingerprinting. This website loads no analytics or advertising scripts and no third-party scripts at all, and it sets no cookies.
We do not sell or share personal information, because we do not collect any.

sections.h: This website and the web app
p: To work offline and to remember one preference, the web app keeps a little data in your browser. It stays on your device and we cannot see it:
ul: Service worker and cache: copies of the app's own code, fonts, icons and PDF engine files, so the web app opens without a connection. Never your files.
Local storage: one setting, the file size above which the app warns you about large files.
p2: To clear it, open your browser's site settings for this website and delete its stored data, or uninstall the web app if you installed it. This only removes the offline copies and that one setting; the app downloads what it needs again on your next visit.
As an extra safeguard, the web app page carries a browser-enforced security policy that only lets it connect to this website itself, not to any other site.

ul: Vercel hosts this website. Like any web host, it keeps standard request logs (for example IP address, time, the page requested and browser type) to deliver the site and keep it secure. We add no tracking of our own.

GitHub hosts the Windows app's downloads and update files, and the project's issues page. When you download from GitHub or the app checks it for updates, GitHub sees that request, including your IP address.
Hugging Face hosts the optional AI model files the Windows app can download (see below). When you agree to a download, Hugging Face sees that request.
p2: These services have their own privacy policies, which apply to what they collect. We do not control them.

sections.h: The Windows app and the internet
p: The Windows app works fully offline. It connects to the internet only in these cases:
ul: AI models (optional). Speech to text, background removal and face detection need a model file. DropFlow downloads one only after you agree, and first shows its name, size and source. The file is checked against a known SHA-256 fingerprint before it is used. Only the model request is made; nothing about your files is sent.
Update check. An installed copy asks GitHub Releases whether a newer version exists, and downloads it only when you choose to install it. The request carries nothing about you or your files.
Open from link. If you type or paste a web address, DropFlow downloads that one file with a plain GET request: no cookies, and nothing about your own files is sent.

Helper programs (optional). A few tools can use a helper program such as FFmpeg. DropFlow does not offer to install helpers unless you turn that on in Settings or press Install; the installation is done by Windows' winget, which downloads from the helper's publisher.

Send to phone. This starts a temporary web server on your local network, only while its window is open, so a phone on the same Wi-Fi can fetch the file. Only devices on your local network that have the link or QR code can reach it. Close the window to stop it.

sections.h: Data stored by the Windows app
p: The Windows app stores its settings, a history of your recent conversions (the operation, file names and paths, and where the results were saved, never the file contents), a local log file and any AI models you downloaded in your Windows user profile, by default under %LocalAppData%\DropFlow. This data stays on your PC. You can delete it at any time by deleting that folder.

DropFlow is a general-purpose file tool and is not directed at children. We do not knowingly collect personal information from anyone, including children. There are no accounts and no data collection, so there is nothing to delete on our side.
If we change how DropFlow handles data, we will update this page and its effective date. Please check back from time to time.

PDF sign adds a visible stamp to the page. It is not a legal or cryptographic digital signature. It does not prove who signed or whether the file changed afterwards, and it may not be accepted where a real digital signature is required.

PDF redact removes the text or regions you choose from the result. It can only find words that exist in the PDF's text layer; scanned pages need you to mark the regions yourself. Redacted pages become images, so their selectable text, links and form fields are lost. Always check the result before you share it.
PDF crop only changes the visible area. Content cropped away is still inside the file. Use redact when content must be removed.
AI features (speech to text, background removal, face detection, OCR) can make mistakes or miss things. Check their results.
